CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A

  JUNE 2024 AGENDA

MEMBERS
Barbara Hibler, Chairperson  Peter Puglese, Public Works Department, City Traffic Engineer
Richard Galindo, District 1  Diana Maximo, Parking and Traffic Department (LAZ Parking)
Kip Rudd, District 2  William Thompson, Parking and Traffic Department (LAZ Parking)
Brett C.S. Roberts, District 3  Lieutenant David Salcedo, Police Department
Lois Hale, District 4

Rules of Decorum, https://www.cityofinglewood.org/DocumentCenter/View/18857/2023-Rules-of-Decorum

A. OPENING CEREMONIES
1. Roll Call

B. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any item on the agenda, other
  than the Public Hearing, may do so at this time.

C. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
1. Approval of the Minutes for the Meeting held on May 22, 2024. Refer pages 3-7 of this agenda.

D. UNFINISHED BUSINESS
1. City-owned parking facilities as parking meter zones with special event parking rates and fines.
  Options being studied for implementing event parking rates/fines for public parking lots. To view
  and read the staff report click on the following site link
  https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Item/16627?fileID=23655
  a. Requesting a Status Update

E. NEW BUSINESS
1. Commissioner Rudd will open the discussion on the following topic.
  a. Implementation of event parking rates/fines for on-street parking meters on Manchester
  Boulevard between Prairie Avenue and La Brea Avenue.

  b. Requesting a presentation on expanded scope of services for parking enforcement.
   Staff report recommending that the Mayor and Council Members approve Amendment No. 2 to
  Agreement No. 14-142 with LAZ Karp Associates, LLC (LAZ), extending the contract from June
  1, 2024, to May 31, 2029; modifying the scope of services; and increasing the maximum annual
  compensation.
  https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Item/17247?fileID=24286

F. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any matter connected with City
  business not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

G. CHAIRPERSON AND COMMISSIONERS REMARKS
1. The members of the Parking and Traffic Commission will provide oral reports, including reports on
  City related travels where lodging expenses are incurred, and/or address any matters they deem of
  general interest to the public.

H. ANNOUNCEMENTS
1. The next Parking and Traffic Commission meeting will be held on Wednesday, July 24, 2024 at 7:00
  p.m., First Floor, City Hall Community Room A, Inglewood City Hall One Manchester Blvd.,
  Inglewood, CA 90301.

I. ADJOURNMENT

JUNE 2024_PTC COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
   CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A

  MAY 2024 MEETING MINUTES

A. OPENING CEREMONIES
 Meeting was held at 7:05 pm (PST) in the Community Room A located in the first floor on 05/22/24
 Attendees included Barbara Hibler, Richard Galindo, Kip Rudd, Lois Hale, Peter Puglese, William
  Thompson, and Police Sergeant Fernandez

B. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEM
 There were no comments from persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on
  any agenda item.

C. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
1. Approval of the Minutes for the Meeting held on March 27, 2024.
 The information appears on pages 3-6 of the agenda for May 22, 2024. The agenda can be
  consulted at the following link, click below to view.
  https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_05222024-4107
 The first motion to accept was made by Commissioner Rudd and seconded by Commissioner
  Galindo. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote: Barbara Hibler, Richard Galindo,
  Kip Rudd and Lois Hale. Everyone agreed on the movement to approve the minute notes.

2. Approval of the Minutes for the Meeting held on April 24, 2024.
 The information appears on pages 7-12 of the agenda for May 22, 2024. The agenda can be
  consulted at the following link, click below to view.
  https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_05222024-4107
 The first motion to accept was made by Commissioner Rudd and seconded by Commissioner Hale.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote: Barbara Hibler, Richard Galindo, Kip Rudd
  and Lois Hale.

D. RESOLUTION
1. Staff report recommending that the Traffic and Parking Commission approve the resolution to
  terminate the Residential Parking Permit Program for 6th Avenue from 104th Street to 108th Street.
 The information appears on pages 13-34 of the agenda for May 22, 2024. The agenda can be
  consulted at the following link, click below to view.
  https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_05222024-4107
 City staff read the adoption of the Resolution recommending the termination of the petition
  mentioned above. A staff report with findings was provided along with the voting results for all to
  follow up. Chairperson Barbara Hibler signed the resolution and it is attached on the following pages
  to the minutes of this meeting for reference.

E. UNFINISHED BUSINESS
1. City-owned parking facilities as parking meter zones with special event parking rates and fines
 To view the staff report click on the following site link, click below to view.
  https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Item/16627?fileID=23655
 Oral status report on the City-owned parking facilities
MAY 2024_PTC COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES1 OF 2
   CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A

  MAY 2024 MEETING MINUTES

a. Mr. Thompson informed the Commission that no discussion activity had occurred.
b. Some of the issues of concern to the commission were signage and public parking for residents
  during events. Therefore, the Commission recommended bringing the matter to the Parking and
  Traffic Commission for review and comment before presenting the report to the City Council.

F. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any matter connected with City
  business not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.
 The 65th Street resident raised the issue of non-resident parking on the street to attend an event.
  The resident asked about the implementation of the Citywide Residential Permit Parking Program
  on 65th Street between Chester Ave and Gay Street.
 Commissioner Galindo agreed to assist the resident to give him guidance.

G. CHAIRPERSON AND COMMISSIONERS REMARKS
1. The members of the Parking and Traffic Commission will provide oral reports, including reports on
  City related travels where lodging expenses are incurred, and/or address any matters they deem of
  general interest to the public.
 There were no comments on any agenda items.

H. ANNOUNCEMENTS
1. It was announced that the next Traffic and Parking Commission meeting will be Wednesday, June
  26, 2024 at 7:00 p.m., 1st Floor, City Hall Community Room A, Inglewood City Hall One Manchester
  Boulevard, Inglewood, CA 90301

I. ADJOURNMENT
1. The Parking and Traffic Commission meeting ended at 7:51 PM PST.

J. ATTACHMENT
1. Signed Resolution
2. Attendance Sheet
